verdict.summary: The change is internally consistent and complete as a bounded research/reproduction artifact. The comparator adds protocol caveats to both the envelope and every admitted timing row, while preserving existing row shapes when no caveat is supplied; the focused test exercises both populated and default-absent paths and explicitly verifies that rows exist, so it is not vacuous. The csparql2 gather script pins upstream, applies and records the declared iterator-close patch, keeps non-matching scenarios as expected evidence, and attaches the window-semantics qualification to all comparison outputs. The runner's scenario definitions, timestamp handling, SELECT-variable projection, and set-per-report-time counting align with the documented count-only purpose. Claims remain appropriately limited: the comparable surface is not widened, non-canonical timing is not presented as canonical, and the alignment/deadlock limitations are prominent and machine-readable.
